powerOrigins.detail: An Army veteran who paid for the Power Broker's augmentation process, which raised his strength and body to superhuman levels; later boosted while recovering from Protocide's beating.
Studied and copied Captain America's fighting style and was trained by Taskmaster in combat, gymnastics and acrobatics.
Fights with a run of shields, from a vibranium disc and star shield to an energy shield, plus a bulletproof costume.

abilities.name: Superhuman strength
abilities.detail: Can lift over 11 tons and jump more than 20 feet.

abilities.name: Superhuman durability
abilities.detail: Tougher than normal tissue lets him shrug off blows that would badly hurt a person; he has taken hits from Sasquatch and a bomb blast.

sources.label: Marvel Fandom wiki: Alpha Flight Vol 1 104

abilities.name: Superhuman stamina
abilities.detail: His muscles make far fewer fatigue toxins, so he can fight at full effort for hours.

abilities.name: Speed, agility and reflexes
abilities.detail: His speed, coordination and reaction time are all pushed slightly past human limits.

abilities.name: Expert fighter
abilities.detail: A superb soldier and tactician who modelled his style on Captain America and trained under Taskmaster.

abilities.name: Shield fighting
abilities.detail: Has used many shields over the years, including Captain America's own, a vibranium star shield, an eagle shield and a photon shield.

abilities.name: Pilot and linguist
abilities.detail: Flies aircraft and speaks Arabic and Spanish as well as English.

feats.text: As Super-Patriot, traded blows with Captain America for nearly an hour; neither man could truly beat the other.

sources.label: Marvel Fandom wiki: Captain America Vol 1 327

feats.text: Kept fighting after a pipe strike and a hit from a torchsword, beating Left-Winger and Right-Winger together.

sources.label: Marvel Fandom wiki: Captain America Vol 1 347

feats.text: As warden of the Raft, missing a leg and with a hook for a hand, swiftly put down inmates who tried to escape.
Fought Sam Wilson and Bucky Barnes at once, tearing off Sam's Falcon wings with little effort.
feats.where: The Falcon and The Winter Soldier, episode 5 "Truth" (2021)
